name: Memory (dMemo)
description: Private, encrypted, portable long-term memory backed by 0G Storage. No cloud API key required for embedding or recall; capture never calls an LLM (infer=false always). Optional 0G Router chat inference is separate and never required for the memory leg.

privateKey.description: 0G wallet private key (0x-prefixed hex). Required. No config => memory disabled (fail-open).

scope.description: Base mem0 user_id / isolation namespace. Per-agent sessions are auto-namespaced as `<scope>:agent:<agentId>`.

modelInferenceDocTemplate._comment: Optional, separate from the memory leg. 0G Router is OpenAI-chat-completions-shaped, not /v1/responses-shaped, hence api: 'openai-completions'.
modelInferenceDocTemplate._modelNote: Testnet chat model catalog drifted as of 2026-07-25 (Phase 2 finding): the spec-era 'qwen/qwen2.5-omni-7b (TeeML)' id no longer exists. Current testnet chat model is 'qwen2.5-omni' (TeeTLS, not TeeML). Re-check `GET /v1/models` on the Router before pinning in production; mainnet baseUrl is `https://router-api.0g.ai/v1`.
